transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I guess I'm here because... I just feel like I really don't deserve the trust people put in me. I'm a doctor, and lately I just keep replaying these small clinical imperfections in my head over and over. It's getting to the point where I feel like... like they prove I'm actually a dangerous doctor. I just can't seem to shake that feeling.
When these thoughts come up, do you feel driven to check, review, or reassure yourself to make them go away?

Not really. I mean, I don't go back and constantly check patient charts or ask my colleagues to review my work to reassure me. It's not really an urge to fix it or check it. It's more just... this heavy conviction that stays with me. I just sort of sit with the feeling that I'm doing harm, but I don't do anything to try and make the thoughts go away. They just stay there.
Have you been feeling persistently depressed or down most of the day, nearly every day?

I'm not really sure. I mean... I don't think I feel sad or down most of the day. It's really just that heavy feeling about my work that I mentioned. But as for just feeling depressed all the time... no, I haven't really noticed that.
Outside of your work, do you generally insist that tasks be done in your own particular way, even when other ways would be acceptable?

No, not really. I mean... I don't think I'm overly rigid like that at home. If someone else wants to do a task their own way, that's completely fine with me. I don't really care how things are organized or how chores get done outside of work, as long as they get done. It's really just my medical decisions that weigh on me.
Do these thoughts about your clinical imperfections feel intrusive and unwanted, as though they enter your mind against your will?

No, I wouldn't say they feel intrusive or against my will. It's more like... they just feel true. It's not a sudden thought that pops into my head and bothers me. It's just a constant belief I have about myself and my work. I just feel like I'm doing a bad job, and that's just how it is.
Do you think there is any possibility that your belief about being a dangerous doctor is mistaken, or are you completely certain it is true?

I'm certain it's true. I mean... even when I go back and review the chart, and there is absolutely no evidence of a bad outcome, it doesn't change anything for me. I just keep believing that some routine delay, or an imperfect message I sent, has quietly harmed a patient. And I know that everyone will eventually discover it. So, no, I don't really see a possibility that I'm mistaken.
